scope: Proposition 9.1 of the manuscript “Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level” (preprints/Global-quantum-geometric-Langlands-at-irrational-level-October-4-2026/quantum-langlands.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 069 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d9bc135865dbc97), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 74. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the coordinate charts just described, the t-structure on CS is separated and compatible with filtered colimits. Its heart is a Grothendieck abelian category, and there is a continuous equivalence D(C♡ S ) ≃ CS. (9.1) The functors j!, j∗, i∗ are t-exact when j is a principal open and i is a smooth closed collision diagonal. For a smooth divisor i, the functor i! has amplitude [0, 1]. These assertions also hold for products of the group categories, with separate subsets of the marks assigned to the different factors.
